How each figure is counted

periods, working days, tenure, team rows, metrics, managers, best branch

Periods

MTD = 1 Nov – 15 Nov 2026 (previous: 1 Oct – 15 Oct 2026); WTD = 9 Nov – 15 Nov 2026 (previous: 2 Nov – 8 Nov 2026); Q3 to date = 1 Oct – 15 Nov 2026 (previous: 1 Jul – 15 Aug 2026); YTD = 1 Apr – 15 Nov 2026; Q1 = 1 Apr – 30 Jun 2026 (previous: 1 Jan – 31 Mar 2026); Q2 = 1 Jul – 30 Sep 2026 (previous: 1 Apr – 30 Jun 2026). Data run to 15 Nov 2026 (HR mandays to 14 Nov; 15 Nov is a Sunday). Last year = the same dates in 2025. Previous period = MoM for MTD (the same days of last month), WoW for WTD (the week before), QoQ for the quarters (Q3 to date against the same number of days into Q2). YTD (from 1 Apr) has last year only. Counts (deals, RV, headcount, mandays) get a % change only against last year and the previous period, which cover the same days.

Working days and mandays

Working days = days the branch closed deals (Sundays and holidays have none); they equal HR's highest active days in 19 of 20 months checked. HR holds active days per month only, so mandays inside a part-month window (WTD, MTD comparisons, Q3 to date against Q2) = each person's active days that month × the share of the month's working days that fall in the window. Whole months use HR's days as they are.

Tenure

Months from the HR joining date of the person whose work it is: TME for TME-team deals, appointments set and trunk duration; the B2B-team person for B2B deals; ME for the BDE row and for attended in the All Team JDS row; JDA for JDA deals and presentations. Deals use the tenure on the deal date, per-manday figures and headcount the tenure on the 15th of the month. No HR tenure = deals or appointments whose person is not on the HR sales list with that role that month, has no joining date, or there is no salesperson (Q3 to date, Jaipur: Hot Data 3%, Online 21%, Rest of the JDS teams 46%, B2B team 4%, JDA 10%, BDE 11%, All Team JDA 10%, All Team JDS 9%, Branch 10%). The tenure columns plus No HR tenure add up to All.

Team rows

  • Super Cat, Hot Data, Online, Rest of the JDS teams: JDS deals (joint JDA + JDS deals count half) by the TME team on the deal. Per-manday figures and headcount = the TMEs in that HR team. Rest of the JDS teams = every other TME team (Revival, Bounce, Retention, …) and JDS deals with no team on them.
  • B2B team (its own team since 16 Nov, at the user's choice): every B2B deal of the branch, in full (B2B deals are never shared with a JDA). People = HR's B2B team; HR books them all as JDA, while in the official reporting lines the team was BDEs (closers) until September and mostly TMEs from October. Tenure = the B2B person on the deal (the TME slot first, then the closer). The sales dashboard adds B2B deals and mandays into its JDA team; this page does not.
  • JDA = All Team JDA: JDA deals (joint deals count half), mandays and headcount of JDAs outside the B2B team. JDA + B2B team = the sales dashboard's JDA team.
  • BDE (the dashboard's JDS-ME without B2B): JDS deals closed by an ME of the branch that month, wherever the business is; ME tenure, mandays and headcount. The MEs' B2B deals sit in the B2B row.
  • All Team JDS = Super Cat + Hot Data + Online + Rest of the JDS teams. Branch = every deal = All Team JDA + All Team JDS + B2B team + deals with no salesperson.
  • Area: deals by the deal's Main/Remote flag (it follows the TME), appointments by the appointment's flag, mandays and headcount by the person's HR Main/Remote. Main + Remote = All.

Metrics

  • Deals per manday, RV per manday: the All column = the row's deals (and their RV 3-yr) ÷ the row's mandays, as on the sales dashboard. Tenure columns = deals credited to the people in that band while on the HR list ÷ their mandays. Branch divides by TME + JDA + B2B mandays (the dashboard leaves ME mandays out).
  • Share of the row's deals / RV (tenure contribution) = the band's deals (RV) ÷ the row's total. Headcount = people on the HR list with active days that month, averaged over the window's months by working days.
  • RV / deal = RV 3-yr ÷ deals. Collection per deal includes the against-bounce ECS collection the sales dashboard adds. ECS % = ECS deals ÷ deals.
  • Product = the product group on the deal: package, PDG, or other products (banners, JD Trusted, mobile banner, add-ons sold alone). Share of deals and RV / deal per product.
  • Appointments attended per manday: TME rows = attended appointments the team set ÷ its TME mandays; B2B = B2B appointments the B2B team set ÷ B2B mandays; BDE and All Team JDS = JDS appointments the MEs attended ÷ ME mandays; Branch = all appointments MEs attended ÷ ME mandays. Attended = Dealclosed, Follow Up or Not Interested, as on the sales dashboard.
  • Appointments given per TME manday = appointments given by the row's TMEs (the ME's own left out) ÷ their mandays. COG % = deals ÷ appointments given (B2B: B2B deals ÷ B2B appointments).
  • Avg trunk duration = minutes of trunk duration on the people's dialer calls ÷ their mandays. Dialer copies exist from Jan 2026 for Jaipur, so there is no last-year figure.
  • Avg presentations = JDA presentations (JDA / Both, Points or Revenue above 0) ÷ JDA mandays, from 16 Apr 2026 only (no last-year figure).
  • 1st ECS clearance: no data source found yet for 2026 deals; the row is kept empty. eNACH eligibility and link-sent were left out: no source found.

Managers

From the official reporting lines (copies of 2 Jul, 7 Sep and 12 Oct 2026; months up to July use the July copy). Each person's team leader = their direct manager; the manager = the team leader's manager. When a person reports straight to a manager, the line reads "· direct reportees". Deals are credited to the person (TME, B2B person, JDA or closing ME) while on the HR list; the gap to the grid's row total is deals whose person is not on the branch's HR list that month. There are no reporting lines for 2025, so managers have no last-year comparison. The JDA head and the branch head are shown by role, not by name.

Best branch

For each cell, the highest figure among Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Chandigarh, Chennai, Coimbatore, Delhi, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune in the same period (lowest for Non-ECS %). A branch counts only with a base of at least 30 deals, 150 mandays or 100 appointments in that cell, scaled down for short periods (working days ÷ 25, at least a fifth). Jaipur's rank is among the same branches.

Read with care

  • Attended in Oct–Nov: on several days the appointment data lost outcomes MEs had entered (mostly Not Available / Not Interested), mainly for businesses outside the 8 big cities, Jaipur among them. Attended counts since October are lower than what MEs marked.
  • Rest of the JDS teams: some deals still carry Revival / Bounce / Retention as their team while few TMEs remain in those HR teams, so its per-manday figures since October rest on very few mandays.
  • Small cells (grey italic) can swing a lot between periods, especially in WTD.
